transcript: Put baking soda on your flabby legs and watch what happens. Fill a basin with warm water, add two tablespoons of baking soda and a handful of coarse salt. Soak your legs for 15 to 20 minutes. Baking soda alkalizes the skin and draws out toxins that have been building up in your tissues for years. The salt flushes out fluid retention and reduces swelling from the ankles up. The warm water opens the pores and activates circulation so both compounds penetrate deeper. Together they tighten loose skin, reduce retention, improve circulation and leave your legs firmer and lighter. Even skin that has been flabby for years starts to regain tone. Do it three times a week before going to sleep. When you finish, pat dry gently without rubbing and do not rinse. Let the minerals keep working while you sleep. In a few weeks you will notice the difference. Your legs look more defined, the heaviness disappears and that feeling of tired legs goes away. Save this recipe. But I want you to understand something. Your legs are not flabby just because of age or lack of exercise. Skin loses firmness when collagen is destroyed and what destroys collagen more than anything. Cortisol, the stress hormone. When you live under stress, your body releases cortisol every day and cortisol breaks down the collagen in your skin. Fluid retention is not always about salt. Many times it is stress. Stress affects the kidneys and they hold on to what they should be releasing. That is why there are women who take care of their legs with everything and they are still flabby and swollen because they treat the skin from the outside. But what is destroying it is still on the inside. Write in the comments firm legs if you are going to try it and if you want to restore firmness from the root. I have spent more than 20 years quietly learning how to do it and everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
